brief: 5 prompt engineering patterns that separate amateurs from pros in 2026.

slots.subline: Five engineering patterns that turn lazy prompts into precision instruments. Master them before the algorithm masters you.

slots.body: In 2026, chat is not a search bar. Pros treat prompts as executable code, not polite requests. Structure wins.
Before generating output, ask the model to critique and rewrite your prompt for clarity. A sharper input always guarantees a sharper result.
Don't dump complex tasks into one prompt. Break them into specialized sub-agents that run in parallel, then synthesize their outputs into one coherent final draft.
Static few-shot is dead. Inject dynamically retrieved examples that match the current context. Relevance beats volume when you want consistent tone and format.
Ask the model to argue against its own answer before finalizing. One adversarial pass catches hallucinations, logic gaps, and bias that linear generation misses.
Treat your context window like RAM. Explicitly allocate tokens to role, constraints, examples, and output format. Waste nothing, gain precision.
Start engineering your prompts like a pro. The amateurs are already falling behind.
